contradictions.what: Rep first says the trigger was the portal (per inbound), then says portal was only an excuse and the real trigger was the CFO's close.
Rep says three weeks of nothing after the first proposal, but later says she lost a month pitching the portal; durations differ.
Rep had the deal at 20 percent and 'dead' before the ROI meeting, yet describes it as won and only paperwork afterward, while a stated unresolved reference gap remained.
Rep says Paul was her day-to-day and the first proposal went to him; Ines as decider was not identified until about the third call.
